fat_pct.quote: The average values for protein, fat, carbohydrate and ash content are 15.23% 22.80%, 0.72% and 2.60%, and percentages of protein (PDB%), fat (FDB %), carbohydrate (CDB%) and ash (ADB%) on a dry basis are calculated as 37.31, 55.85, 1.76 and 6.36, respectively.

ph.quote: On the 3rd week, the pH value of AP group increased from 4.2 to 5.0 and were higher than MAP and VP groups.

ammonia.reason: Limited deamination and early proteolysis in young 2-week lactic curd with rind deacidification just beginning.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole from raw goat milk pasture transfer plus surface Geotrichum/coryneform activity.

bitter.reason: Some hydrophobic peptides from small rennet addition and starter peptidases, balanced by high acidity.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; only trace methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from Penicillium candidum rind.

browning.reason: Low pH and low residual sugar limit Maillard reaction; rind only tans on extended drying.

buttery.reason: Modest diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism, masked by acidity and lipolysis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Elevated C4-C8 free fatty acids butyric/hexanoic/octanoic from lipase lipolysis of goat fat.

creaminess.reason: Fat-in-dry-matter ~56% softens under bloomy rind via proteolysis but acid core remains chalky.

crumbliness.reason: Low-pH calcium-depleted casein network fractures without elasticity, typical lactic goat paste.

firmness.reason: Acid-drained dense lactic curd at ~59% moisture formed into small 60-90g cylinder.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from yeast Ehrlich catabolism of phenylalanine.

fruity.reason: Yeast and Geotrichum candidum esterification producing ethyl butanoate/hexanoate during ripening.

goaty.reason: Branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids from goat milk triglycerides released by lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal from limited proteolysis in short 2-week ripening.

melt.reason: Acid pH ~4.2 solubilizes colloidal calcium phosphate preventing casein flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and geosmin from Geotrichum candidum and Penicillium candidum surface flora.

oil_off.reason: Fat entrapped in acid gel with limited coalescence; little free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol formation in lactic bloomy make.

sour_vinegar.reason: High L-lactic acid plus acetic acid from prolonged lactic fermentation at pH 4.2-5.0.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading and acid-demineralized curd lacks intact para-casein for fiber formation.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No cook step and minimal methionine catabolism to methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide by starter.

sweet.reason: Most lactose fermented to lactate with ~0.7% residual carbs leaving little sweet lactose.

umami.reason: Modest free glutamate from chymosin and starter peptidase proteolysis in short-aged paste.
